<h3>Replay System Info</h3>
<p><strong>Replays will become available on VALORANT PC starting with Patch 11.06 for all regions other than China.</strong></p>
<ul>
  <li>Patch 11.06 will deploy on September 16 or 17 depending on your region at 9:00AM PT.</li>
  <li>Replays will be available in China starting with Patch 11.07b on October 9 local China time.</li>
  <li>Replays will be available for <strong>VALORANT Console</strong> starting with Patch 11.10 on November 11 or 12 depending on your region at 9:00AM PT.</li>

  <li>Observe the game with a third-person free observer cam</li>
  <li>Fast-forward, slow down, and pause the game. (Speeds: .1x, .25x, .5x, 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x)</li>
  <li>Skip to each round of the game.</li>
  <li>Time-jump to anywhere in the game.
    <ul>
      <li>You’ll also see small icons on the timeline to signify where kills, deaths, and ultimate ability usage took place.</li>

Some of these issues we’re hoping to fix in a future patch, but others are inherent to Replays in VALORANT and will continue to persist.</p><p><strong>Mini/Mega Map Fog of War </strong>- While you can toggle enemy outlines on or off to reflect the visual info available to each player’s first-person POV, you cannot hide that info from the minimap or megamap. So even if you can’t see an enemy behind a wall with outlines toggled off, you will still see them on the minimap.</p><p><strong>Ability Minimaps </strong>- Ability minimaps like Brimstone’s Sky Smoke, Clove’s Ruse, Tejo’s Guided Salvo, Armageddon, etc. will not be viewable in a Replay. From that player’s first-person POV, you will see the Agent raise their hands when placing the abilities, but there will be no in-game map to see exactly where they’re being placed. Once the abilities are deployed, the minimap and in-game world will show the abilities.</p><p><strong>Ability Placement Markers</strong> - Similar to the ability minimaps above, ability placement markers like KJ’s turret outline, Deadlock’s Sonic Sensor preview, Cypher’s Trapwire preview, etc will also not be viewable when a player is placing them in a Replay.
